verdict.rationale: Segment documents building Audiences from events, traits and computed traits and syncing them to hundreds of destinations, including engagement tools like HubSpot and Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Engage is described as 'powered by real-time data', but the evidence never confirms continuous sync or near-real-time membership changes. missing for 10: explicit documentation of continuous/real-time audience computation and sync cadence, handling of membership entry/exit (add/remove) at destinations, named ad-platform audience destinations, independent or hands-on corroboration of sync latency.
